name: Bundt cake (sour cream)
origin: Named for the fluted ring pan (Bundt is a registered trademark of Nordic Ware, from 1950), not a distinct batter tradition; the classic home-baking filling for that pan is a rich, close-crumbed sour-cream pound-cake-style batter.

ingredients.note: sour cream, modelled with the registry's cream substance as the nearest real analogue — see the same note in coffee-crumb-cake.json

process.name: cream butter and sugar
process.description: beat butter and sugar until light

process.name: add eggs and sour cream
process.description: beat in eggs, then sour cream

process.name: fold in flour
process.description: fold in flour, leavening and salt

process.name: bake
process.description: bake in a well-greased fluted ring pan

notes: A dense, sour-cream-enriched pound-cake relative, close in proportion to pound-cake.json and to coffee-crumb-cake.json's own sour-cream batter, chosen for a batter rich and structurally sound enough to hold the fine detail of a fluted mould without tearing on release.
